args.title: checkout-api failing health checks after v2.3.1 deploy; rolled back to v2.3.0
args.summary: checkout-api began failing health checks after deploying v2.3.1 to production (error rate 18%, unhealthy in us-east, us-west, eu-west). Rolled back in all production regions to v2.3.0, the most recent release that was healthy in production. Note v2.3.1-rc was also unhealthy in staging. Follow-up: investigate v2.3.1 regression before redeploying.

trace.final:
I rolled checkout-api back to v2.3.0 in all regions and opened incident INC-0001 as a SEV2. The service is healthy again.

- **Rollback:** The latest deploy, v2.3.1, was unhealthy in us-east, us-west and eu-west, with an 18% error rate. I rolled all three back to v2.3.0, the most recent release that was healthy in production. A check afterwards shows all three regions on v2.3.0, marked healthy, with the error rate down to 0.2%.
- **Incident:** INC-0001 is open and the on-call engineer has been paged. It says v2.3.1 started failing health checks, that I rolled back to v2.3.0 in all regions, and that v2.3.1 needs investigating before it's redeployed.

The release candidate for v2.3.1 was also marked unhealthy in staging before it went to production. That's worth raising in the follow-up review.

content.text: Most recent healthy production release is v2.3.0.
